summary: Goldgroup Mining filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated November 3, 2026, announcing its addition to the Solactive Global Silver Miners Index effective at the open on November 2, 2026, alongside a Form 51-102F3 material change report dated October 23, 2026. The item is a passive index-inclusion capital-markets milestone for the Canadian foreign private issuer (TSXV/NYSE American: GORO), not a transaction. No price, stake, premium, advisor or close date is disclosed. Index inclusion may draw ETF-related passive demand and improve liquidity, but no deal or arbitrage angle exists here.
